paragraphs: A comprehensive collection of production-ready website components built with Next.js, Shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS. Perfect for developers looking to quickly build modern, responsive websites with the power of shadcn/ui components.
Tailwind v4 + React 19: Launch UI v2.0 adds full support for Tailwind v4, React 19 and Next.js 16. If you're using Tailwind 3, a version that supports it is still maintained on a separate branch.
Launch UI was made for products that need a great-looking, conversion-optimized landing page that speaks to professional quality-oriented audiences.
features: 🎨 Modern Design System: Built on top of shadcn/ui, offering a clean and professional look
📱 Fully Responsive: All components work perfectly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
⚡ Performance Optimized: Leverages modern Next.js features for optimal loading speed
🌗 Dark Mode Support: Seamless light/dark mode switching with system preference detection
♿ Accessibility First: WCAG compliant components for inclusive web experiences
